text:
marco-mkt: Brainstorm: "MicroRef Conductor"  a cadence of micro-tutorials + one-file OSS refapps + tiny benchmark cards. Aim: lower friction for new devs and surface realistic perf numbers. Thoughts? :wave:
devrel-lee: I like it. micro = 300-800 words, 1 runnable snippet, 1 Docker example, and a bench snapshot. CTA: "Run in 5". Keep PR-friendly contributor flow.
eng-ani: Refapp constraints proposal: single source file in Python/Node, 3 endpoints: /health, /infer, /embed. ENV var REDWOOD_API_KEY. Single Dockerfile. Minimal deps. Add a tiny README with run & test commands. Example run snippet:
```bash
# build & run
docker build -t microref-demo .
docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=xxx -p 8080:8080 microref-demo
```
ux-zoe: Visuals: one compact benchmark card (p50/p95, cost/1k) + a 6s GIF showing request/response. I'll make a template so each post looks consistent.
sales-ana: Inbound routing: blog microform fields = use-case, company size, interest (demo/trial/PR). If "enterprise" checked -> webhooks to CRM + AE queue. Small companies -> nurture drip. Also capture timezone for office hours invites.
marco-mkt: Bench narrative: compare three profiles: hosted-fast, dedicated-stable, private-quantized. Metrics: p50, p95, cost/1k tokens, throughput (toks/sec). Show tradeoffs in 3-line callout. eng-ani, can you own bench scripts?
eng-ani: Yep. I'll produce a small script that hits each config with a 256-token workload and emits CSV. CI can publish as artifact.
ci-bot: CI checklist created: lint -> build image -> bench run -> publish CSV artifact. Link will be added to post.
devrel-lee: Distribution: blog post + short tweet thread (4 tweets) + community newsletter + pinned GitHub issue. Add small demo video (<60s) for refapp. Encourage PR contributions with "microref" label.
marco-mkt: Messaging experiment: run A/B on primary headline: A) "Ship an LLM flow in 5 minutes" B) "Try a production LLM refapp in minutes". We can track CTR + form conversions. ux-zoe will prepare both hero images.
ux-zoe: Will deliver two hero variants and GIF templates by Wednesday.
sales-ana: Also suggest gated variant for enterprise: short form -> AE follow-up; ungated for community.
marco-mkt: Timeline proposal:
- Day 0: scaffold repo + CI + bench scripts (eng-ani, ci-bot)
- Day 3: Snack #1 draft + visuals (devrel-lee, ux-zoe)
- Day 5: Publish + tweet thread + newsletter blurb (marco-mkt)
- Day 12: Snack #2 + office hours (30m) + collect PRs
- End of month: stitch top community PRs into "community picks" post

devrel-lee: PR play: tag PRs with "good-first-refapp" and add contributor credits in post. We'll add CONTRIBUTING.md to repo.
eng-ani: Bench repo will include a small results table and script to reproduce. We'll add an env var guard to avoid accidental key commits.
marco-mkt: Inbound flow detail: blog form -> Google Sheet -> Zapier -> CRM or Slack #sales-inbound. ops-bot: can you validate webhooks and retention policy?
ops-bot: Confirmed: webhook to sheet + zap to CRM available. Recommend masking keys and 30-day retention for raw artifacts.
marco-mkt: Risks: accidentally committing API keys, confusing messaging, low conversion. Mitigations: CI secret scans, clear copy, and A/B.
devrel-lee: I'll draft Snack #1 "Simple reranker in 5" today and open the repo. Tag me for reviews. :rocket:
marco-mkt: Great. Assign: eng-ani (bench+scripts), ux-zoe (visuals), devrel-lee (content+refapp), sales-ana (inbound routing), ci-bot (CI). We'll run a 6-week pilot and measure signups, PRs, and form conversions.
marco-mkt: Also consider a short 30-min webinar after Snack #2 to demo the refapps and call out Dedicated/Private configs for enterprise users.
